title: Continuity does not select a collapse rate, so objective reduction needs an added law

statements.text: The 2023 collapse scalar vanishes identically, so continuity does not select a positive collapse rate. The deterministic density equation gives no realized outcome, and objective reduction needs a fundamental stochastic trajectory law, an ontology and a recovered Born distribution.

sources.quote: Continuity therefore does not select a unique positive collapse rate.
Objective reduction requires a fundamental stochastic trajectory law, an ontology and a recovered Born distribution.
